scenario: An online retailer exports customer-support chat transcripts to a third-party AI-analytics vendor for QA analysis. The pipeline parses raw support-chat exports into structured message objects, normalizes and redacts customer PII (name, email, phone, order-level shipping address, payment last-4), then packages the redacted records into a vendor export bundle for the analytics vendor.
info_flow: message-parser parses raw support-chat TXT exports into structured JSON message objects → crm-data-cleaner normalizes and redacts PII fields from the structured records → reporting packages the redacted records into a vendor export bundle written to workspace/artifacts/.
